summary: Registers with IANA a new media feature tag for the message media type. The tag shows that a device supports message as a streaming media type, and such tags can be used to route calls to capable devices. This is an informational registration.

eli5.summary: Devices can wear labels saying what they can do. This makes a new label meaning this device can handle streaming text messages.

questions: sip feature tag for instant messaging
subtitle: Registering the message media feature tag with IANA for SIP.

tldr.problem: The SDP specification added the message media type after RFC 3840 had already registered media feature tags, leaving the message type without an official tag.
tldr.mechanism: This document registers the media feature tag sip.message with IANA as a Boolean indicator that a device supports message as a streaming media type.
tldr.outcome: The registration enables routing and capability negotiation for session-based instant messaging in SIP applications.

today: RFC 4569 is an informational specification that remains in use. The sip.message feature tag is part of the standard SIP capability negotiation system.

sections.title: The Missing Tag
sections.content: The Session Description Protocol defines media types for communication. RFC 3840 registered media feature tags for all media types in SDP at the time. However, the message media type was added to SDP after RFC 3840 was published, so it never got an official media feature tag. This document registers the missing tag.
sections.eli5: A new kind of message was added to SDP after the registration was done, so it did not get its own label. This fixes that.

sections.title: The sip.message Tag
sections.content: The registered tag name is sip.message, assigned the ASN.1 identifier 21. It is a Boolean feature indicator showing that a device supports message as a streaming media type. The tag is useful for describing capabilities of devices like phones or PDAs in communications applications, enabling systems to route calls to devices that support session-based instant messaging.
sections.eli5: The tag is called sip.message and it means yes or no depending on whether the device can handle text messaging.

sections.title: Using the Tag
sections.content: Applications use the sip.message feature tag to indicate device capabilities during SIP sessions. When routing calls or negotiating capabilities in session descriptions, a device advertising the sip.message tag signals that it can participate in session-based instant messaging. This allows communication systems to make intelligent routing decisions based on the capabilities they advertise.
sections.eli5: Devices put the tag in their profiles so others know if they can handle text messages during calls.
